standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of an ample family
standard_prerequisites.use: Finitely many invertible modules with sections whose nonvanishing loci are affine and cover X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite-cover criterion for the resolution property
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes once the complement ideals are quotients of finite locally free modules.

core_obligations: Since X is quasi-compact, choose finitely many pairs (L_i, s_i), i = 1..n, with the nonvanishing loci U_i affine and covering X.
Let I_i be the image of s_i: L_i^{tensor -1} -> O_X; this is a finite type quasi-coherent ideal vanishing exactly off U_i.
Each I_i is a quotient of the finite locally free module L_i^{tensor -1}; apply the carded finite-cover criterion to conclude X has the resolution property.
proof_roadmap: Finite subfamily selection; ideal identification; criterion application.
difficulty_reason: A short but complete instantiation of the carded finite-cover criterion.
